# workers-git

## Classes

### OysterKeys

Named keys an owner issues directly: an Ear Tag key store scoped to this tenant.
A key's id is the name the owner chose for it, so forks and other name-derived
identities (`service.ts:95`) stay stable across a reissue. Plaintext keys are
never stored.

- `DurableObject`\<[`OysterKeysEnv`](#oysterkeysenv)\>

```ts
issue(owner, input): Promise<KeyOutcome<Readonly<{
  key: string;
```

## Functions

### createArtifactsGit()

```ts
function createArtifactsGit(binding, prefix, grant): ArtifactsGit;
```

The GIT binding over Artifacts for one installation (`prefix` scopes its names).
Credentials remain host-held and are reused until thirty seconds before the
provider expiry or eight minutes, whichever comes first. Every operation still
checks its captured grant. Provider 401/403 discards the credential for remint.
